tools.name: search_slots
tools.description: Search the Reelagio slot database by name, provider, theme, feature, volatility, mechanic, max win or emoji tags. All filters combine with AND. Call list_vocabulary first to get valid theme, feature, provider and emoji values. Results are sorted by popularity and include a link to each slot page. Wi

tools.name: get_slot
tools.description: Get the full spec sheet for one slot: provider, grid, paylines/ways, mechanic, volatility, max win, features, themes, emoji tags and bonus buy. Accepts a slot id, URL slug or name.

tools.name: similar_slots
tools.description: Find slots that play like a given slot, scored on mechanic, grid, volatility, max win, themes and features. Each match explains why it is similar.

tools.name: list_vocabulary
tools.description: List the valid providers, themes, features and emoji tags in the database, with how many slots use each.
